query: select jsonb_build_object('observed_at',clock_timestamp(),'database',current_database(),'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),'ledger',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'tail',max(version)) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),'sequence',(select jsonb_build_object('oid',c.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'acl',c.relacl::text,'type_oid',s.seqtypid,'start',s.seqstart::text,'increment',s.seqincrement::text,'min',s.seqmin::text,'max',s.seqmax::text,'cache',s.seqcache::text,'cycle',s.seqcycle) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace join pg_sequence s on s.seqrelid=c.oid where n.nspname='public' and c.relname='customer_number_seq')) as catalog_receipt;
boundaries: Every pg_sequence bigint configuration value cast to text in SQL before transport; no bigint JSON precision loss.
No current sequence value, is_called, last_value, nextval, currval or setval was read or invoked.
Separate later observation, not a rewritten timestamp for the wave2 catalog; only configuration metadata, not production or native acceptance.
